label: light_scalar_mesons_pdg2025
purpose: The kernel option KernelConfig.light_scalar_mesons (2026-10-11): the f0(980) record, the three a0(980) charge states and their classes in the neutral mesonic family and the non-strange baryonic family. Diagnosis: _knowledge/evidence/fixed-kernel-residual-mechanisms-2026-10-03.md (the probes at the R91 optimum: the kaon-pair states). The committed catalog carries no light meson below the phi(1020) that decays into K Kbar, and in the committed kernel a non-strange baryonic vertex opens no kaon-pair channel.
fraction_rule: each mode enters at the PDG value (a ratio quoted only as a spread of measurements at the midpoint of the spread); the fractions of a record are normalized to unity; each mode is split over the charge states by its isospin Clebsch-Gordan share (pi pi of I = 0: pi+ pi- : pi0 pi0 = 2 : 1; K Kbar of a neutral state: K+ K- : K0 K0bar = 1 : 1); the neutral kaons are K0 and K0bar, as in the K*(892) tables; the orbital L is 0 (S-wave, J^P = 0+); each line shape runs from its lightest threshold to the pole plus five widths, as the committed f2(1270) and a2(1320) records
source: https://pdg.lbl.gov/2025/listings/rpp2025-list-f0-980.pdf and rpp2025-list-a0-980.pdf (S. Navas et al. (Particle Data Group), Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024) and 2025 update; created 2025-12-02)

records.name: f0(980)
records.pdg: MASS 990 +- 20 MeV OUR ESTIMATE; WIDTH 10 to 100 MeV OUR ESTIMATE; Gamma(pi pi)/[Gamma(pi pi) + Gamma(K Kbar)] 0.52 +- 0.12 (AUBERT 06O), 0.75 (ABLIKIM 05Q), 0.84 +- 0.02 (ANISOVICH 02D), ~0.68 (OLLER 99B), 0.67 +- 0.09 (LOVERRE 80), 0.81 (CASON 78), no average
records.rule: pole_mass: the estimate; nominal_width: the midpoint of the estimate's range; pi pi : K Kbar = 0.68 : 0.32, the midpoint of the measured 0.52-0.84

records.name: a0(980)0
records.pdg: MASS 980 +- 20 MeV OUR ESTIMATE; WIDTH 50 to 100 MeV OUR ESTIMATE; Gamma(K Kbar)/Gamma(eta pi) 0.172 +- 0.019 OUR AVERAGE
records.rule: pole_mass: the estimate; nominal_width: the midpoint of the estimate's range; eta pi : K Kbar = 1 : 0.172

classes.rule: the I = 0 neutral mesonic family takes the scalar pairs of isospin 0, (omega, f0), (a0 0, pi0), (a0 +, pi-) and (a0 -, pi+), beside the f2(1270), a2(1320) and phi classes; the committed baryonic_np family takes (N, f0(980)) beside the (N, f0(500)) class of the isoscalar dipion; the isospin completion rotates it to the charge partners, the I = 3/2 families take it at Clebsch-Gordan weight 0, and the conjugate towers carry its conjugate
